# Longitudinal acquired habit and relearning readiness — 2026-10-03

LOCAL DISPOSITION; no owner ruling. Counters1508/0. Brief12.15-8 remains PARTIAL.
Use the routine experiment's original histories and preserved candidates; do not
reinterpret its negative-outcome extinction as relearning or physiological recovery.

The routine profile supplies actual six-opportunity practice, admitted cue/outcome
history, an interruption, corrected reward belief, recent native episode expiry and
later cue response or goal-supported inhibition. One later negative performed outcome
lowers exponential cue strength below1/2 and ends further learned availability.
Its horizon supplies no later positive reacquisition. The native recent journal is
not the HABIT journal; their distinct owners and evidence identities must stay explicit.

In particular, the original native recent journal contains source skill/social/person
observations, not these new receiving practice episodes. Its expiry cannot prove loss
of the remembered practice episode itself. If the next claim is habit retention despite
forgetting its own practice, admit that actual practice into an episodic owner and show
its later loss separately from durable cue history; otherwise retain that stronger
claim as OPEN. A full retained fold journal is not evidence of memory compression.

Next gate: extend a successor profile to include actual inhibition followed by release,
then actual renewed practice and admitted positive outcomes, and a later free cue probe
after reward-expectation correction. A positive report or reintroduced opportunity alone
does not constitute relearning. Measure actual prior practice, preserved history across
the episode gap, later availability, current goal/control, chosen action, physical
performance and accepted learning separately. Preserve hidden observations and changed
cue controls. No retroactive rewrite of original practice or biography is permitted.

Reuse unchanged HABIT/CONTROL append/fold and goal lifecycle functions first. Keep
Derived/Stored and ExplicitBeliefOnly, EraseHistory and ScheduledOnly. Current Stored
versus Derived equality compares read strategies with a diagnostic fold cache in both;
it does not establish a cache-free or compressed-state representation. A different
representation claim needs a separate explicit owner/state comparison. All stochastic
equalities and delayed actions remain in the denominator. Reuse source evidence only
with a prospectively frozen authenticated decomposition and distinct execution counts.

The negative-outcome threshold crossing is a bounded candidate property, not a universal
automaticity/extinction law. Source practice and receiving habit are not the same skill.
Controlled cue and reward reports do not solve natural recognition or causal learning.
New source horizons/inputs require their own admission checks; the existing native
model's frozen source programs cannot be silently extended. Pure component successors
must stay labeled as such. No new allocation or canonical ontology change is presumed.

RO009/012/013/014/015/017/019/020/021 retain the replay, source and reduction obligations.
Habit closure does not close personal-loss12.15-11 or affect dimensionality12.5-8.
RO019 stays ACTIVE and RO021 final historical reconciliation remains unsatisfied.
No fresh native wrapper qualification or whole Campaign3 exit follows from this gate.

# Longitudinal personal loss readiness — 2026-10-03
LOCAL DISPOSITION; no owner ruling. Counters1508/0. Brief12.15-11 remains PARTIAL.

Do not rename episodic forgetting, failed practice, ordinary absence of an opportunity
or a negative reward report as personal loss. This gate needs loss of something the
character already values, grounded in an acquired biography/relationship or maintained
goal, followed by observer-side evidence, appraisal and later behavior.

Inspect the existing RELATIONSHIP, BELIEF, AFFECT, maintained-goal and native LONG
owners before adding state. Prefer a bounded loss of a particular valued relationship
or opportunity over a new general bereavement model. Distinguish continued existence,
physical availability, admitted report, believed loss, current concern and chosen action.
A scheduled absence by itself supplies no negative observation. Hidden world loss with
unchanged safe observations must not change character belief/appraisal. False or missing
reports, later correction and different previously acquired value provide useful controls.

Require actual prior acquisition or maintenance, not only an initialized importance
number. Hold that history fixed while changing admitted loss evidence; hold loss evidence
fixed while varying a lawful acquired history/current goal where possible. Preserve old
meaning and relationship history: a current loss must not rewrite past positive events
or silently retire every goal. Test later actual choices and their independent execution,
not just a scalar distress trace. A countermodel that automatically equates absent
opportunity with goal retirement remains available from the earlier goal gate.

Use existing owned appraisal and feedback routes when they suffice. A stronger universal
affect-dimensionality claim is a separate remaining clause12.5-8; do not invent a new
grief meter solely to force irreducibility. Death, clinical grief, natural language
understanding, general causal inference and permanent psychological recovery are not
automatic requirements of the first bounded loss experiment. Name the supported
phenomenon precisely and preserve any stronger uncovered claim.

Freeze prospective identities, all-seed controls and original-prefix replay before
qualification. Reused native source evidence must be authenticated and counted separately
from fresh execution. Any new source horizon, world effect or public scheduler admission
needs its own explicit gate; prior routine/habit component joins do not confer it.
RO009/010/011/012/013/014/016/017/019/020/021 preserve these limits. RO019 ACTIVE;
RO021 historical reconciliation remains mandatory before Campaign3 exit.
# Longitudinal routine readiness — 2026-10-03

LOCAL DISPOSITION; no owner ruling. Counters1508/0. Start the original longitudinal
partial-coverage audit and CAMPAIGN3_LONGITUDINAL_GOAL_QUALIFICATION.md.

The joined goal checkpoint supplies actual acquired standing, an enduring adopted goal,
episode expiry and later choices. It does not supply a routine: its receiving profile
has no earlier receiving opportunities through8 and only begins at14. Therefore its
later actions cannot be described as resumption of an earlier practiced pattern.

Next gate: actual repeated practice before interruption, an admitted cue/context linking
the opportunities, a period in which the normal opportunity is unavailable, and later
restoration. Measure continuation or resumption from the character's retained goal,
learned cue availability and history. Preserve independently acquired biography across
the same interval. Source schedule labels and caller-selected actions are not evidence
that the character maintains a routine. Ordinary repeated action alone is insufficient.

Inspect/reuse existing HABIT, CONTROL, biological learning and goal lifecycle owners
before adding state. Compare scheduled-only repetition, learned cue availability and
goal-supported organization, including NoHistory/ExplicitBeliefOnly, alternate cue and
retired-goal cases where applicable. Keep actual acquired habit separate from competence
and task instruction. A new Routine object or general planner is not required in advance.
Preserve equal trajectories and test whether a simpler existing mechanism suffices.

If this also claims Brief12.15-8, require the explicit acquired-habit/episodic-retention
comparison: acquire history and biography, remove recent detail, test cue response and
goal inhibition, then relearning. Preserve EraseHistory and stored/derived comparisons.
Do not infer that an admitted habit journal is general episodic memory. Qualify routine
and habit separately if the same experiment fails to discriminate one requirement.

Use exact same-actor ownership or a declared lawful evidence transfer. Bind component
joins and source identities; keep native and component replay surfaces explicit. Preserve
original contracts/model bytes. Freeze prospective identities before qualification, and
complete meaningful whole-prefix/fault/publication checks. The previous expensive save
matrix is finished; do not restart its workers. A more economical execution design may
share demonstrably identical source work only if reuse is declared before the comparison
and never counted as fresh execution or restoration.
